============================================================================
OmniBuf-ES Benchmark Suite (Node.js v24.22.1 / darwin-arm64 / Apple M1 Pro)
Workload: Canonical PeerUpdate (nested submessage, 4 neighbors, arrays, scalars)
============================================================================

### 1. Full Message Encode Speed (PeerUpdate)

| Codec / Operation | Latency (ns/op) | Throughput (ops/sec) | Wire Size (B) | vs Baseline |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| OmniBuf |   1189 ns | 841,290 | 366 | 1.00x (baseline) |
| protobufjs |   1655 ns | 604,239 | 350 | 1.39x slower |
| @bufbuild/protobuf (protobuf-es) |   2797 ns | 357,564 | 350 | 2.35x slower |
| google-protobuf |   5928 ns | 168,678 | 350 | 4.99x slower |
| @msgpack/msgpack |   4023 ns | 248,576 | 622 | 3.38x slower |
| JSON |   2316 ns | 431,868 | 791 | 1.95x slower |
